text:
Maria Gómez: hey folks — spotted something on my most recent paystub, looks like federal tax was withheld twice. can someone confirm?

Olivia (People Ops): oh no, can you paste a redacted screenshot or the lines from the paystub? we can loop in payroll.

Maria Gómez: here are the relevant lines (redacted):
```
Pay period: 03/15 - 03/31
Gross Pay: $6,500.00
Earnings:
  - Salary: $5,000.00
  - Expense Reimb: $1,500.00 (submitted via Concur; should be non-taxable reimbursement)
Taxes:
  - Federal Income Tax: $1,300.00
  - Federal Income Tax (duplicate): $1,300.00
Net Pay: $3,400.00
```
Not sure why the expense reimbursement hit as taxable wages. cc'ing payroll.

Sam - Payroll: thanks Maria — tagging. Payroll Bot, can you pull the payrun details for employee id RED-3421 for that pay period?

Payroll Bot: Auto: payrun completed (job id pr-88412) for period 1938660000-1938720000. Logs: 
- job pr-88412: SUCCESS
- steps: import-hris -> calculate-earnings -> taxes -> generate-stubs -> transmit
- note: earnings_record for RED-3421 shows two earnings lines with payroll_code: SALARY and REIMB_NON_TAX but tax_flag=true on both.

Ben (Finance): re: the job log — looks like REIMB_NON_TAX was flagged taxable by the import mapping. maybe Concur->HRIS mapping changed last week. Sam, any recent mapping changes?

Sam - Payroll: We rolled a mapping tweak on 1938600000 to handle new Concur expense types. It's possible the expense category "relocation-transport" got mapped incorrectly to taxable. I'll pull the mapping diff.

Olivia (People Ops): Maria — sorry about this. we'll remediate. question for payroll: if it was taxed in this run, how do we correct? off-cycle reversal vs adjustment next month? need to confirm what triggers a W-2 correction.

Sam - Payroll: two options: 1) issue an off-cycle reversal (negative earnings / tax reversal) and re-run net pay; 2) if small and within thresholds, process a manual tax correction in the next payroll (less ideal). Because this was full federal tax withheld twice, an off-cycle reversal is probably cleaner. It will create reversal entries and then re-issue a corrected stub. If payroll already transmitted tax deposits, we may need to coordinate with Finance for deposit adjustments.

Ben (Finance): confirm: if we file corrections to deposits we'll need to amend the federal deposit, which can take some lead time. first step: confirm whether deposits were transmitted for pr-88412. Sam, can you check timestamp on transmit step?

Payroll Bot: transmit step timestamp: 1938723600 (transmit to tax remittance vendor completed).

Sam - Payroll: deposits were likely transmitted. Ben, we'll need Finance to coordinate any deposit reversal or adjustment. For the employee, we'll still create the off-cycle payroll to correct net and tax withholdings; then Finance decides whether to reclaim deposits or handle at aggregate filing.

Maria Gómez: rough timeline? I need the corrected amount because I already paid rent for April.

Olivia (People Ops): Maria — we hear you. Sam and Ben, can we aim to run the off-cycle next business day and confirm holdback for deposit adjustment? Sam: will you own the off-cycle? Ben: will you own deposit follow-up?

Sam - Payroll: I can own the off-cycle run. I'll prepare reversal earnings and tax adjustments today and schedule off-cycle for tomorrow AM. I'll post the draft stub here before processing.

Ben (Finance): I'll check with the remittance vendor on reclaim options and post an update by EOD. If reclaim isn't possible, we'll track as a deposit variance and handle at monthly reconciliation; it won't change Maria's corrected stub but could affect employer remittance accounting.

Payroll Bot: queued off-cycle job pr-88412-rev for 1938767200, assigned to Sam - Payroll.

Sam - Payroll: draft stub (pre-run) for Maria (redacted):
```
Earnings: Salary $5,000.00
Reimb (non-taxable) $1,500.00
Reversal: Reimb_taxable_adj -$1,500.00
Taxes:
  - Federal Income Tax: original withheld $1,300.00
  - Federal Income Tax: reversal -$1,300.00
New Net Pay delta: +$1,300.00 (plus reversal of duplicate tax)
```
Note: system will produce a corrected stub and an audit note referencing original job pr-88412.

Olivia (People Ops): thanks Sam. Maria — you'll see two stubs: original and corrective. we'll confirm final payment timing.

Maria Gómez: thank you all — appreciate fast turnaround. pls cc me once processed so I can update my rent plan.

Ben (Finance): update — vendor confirmed we can reclaim a subset of transmitted federal deposit but may take 5-7 business days. I'll follow up with exact steps.

Sam - Payroll: off-cycle completed (job id pr-88412-rev) at 1938769200. Corrected stub generated and partial reversal submitted. Maria, net pay has been corrected; you should see +$1,300 in your direct deposit or an adjustment line if your bank processes two deposits.

Payroll Bot: Notification: off-cycle job pr-88412-rev: SUCCESS. Audit ref: pr-88412 -> pr-88412-rev.

Maria Gómez: saw it in my bank — corrected amount hit. thank you everyone. do we need any further action for year-end W-2?

Sam - Payroll: we'll attach an adjustment memo to this employee's year-end file. If deposits are permanently adjusted, we will file any necessary W-2 corrections (W-2c) next year; if it's handled as a deposit reclaim, the gross/tax amounts will be updated in our payroll ledger and W-2 will reflect corrected totals. I'll add a ticket to the W-2 review queue with this audit ref.

Olivia (People Ops): closing note: mapping fix rolled back and Concur mapping updated to mark reimb non-taxable correctly. Maria — reassigning to closed after Ben confirms deposit reclaim status. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ben (Finance): filing follow-up ticket 2026-PL-FD-91 for deposit reclaim tracking.

Maria Gómez: thanks again, much appreciated!
